# SeoVision MCP tools: annotations and why

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-mcp-annotations.mjs from the server's code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every tool the SeoVision server lists at `https://app.seovision.io/api/directory/mcp` (236 tools), with its three hints and the reason for each. Some tools show only where the feature is switched on for the account.

How the hints are set:

- `readOnlyHint` is true only when the call changes nothing anywhere. Saving a result, queueing a job or a paid AI call counts as a write.
- `destructiveHint` is true for any delete, overwrite, replacement, cancellation, revocation, publication or send, even one that can be undone. It is false only for a purely additive write.
- `openWorldHint` is true when the call reaches anything outside the person's own SeoVision account: their live site, Google, a payment or search data provider, an AI model, a public page or an email.

| Tool | readOnlyHint | destructiveHint | openWorldHint | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `seovision_accept_merge_proposal`<br>Accept a merge proposal | false | true | true | Writes: merges the weaker of two competing articles into the stronger one<br>Destructive: takes a live page off the site and redirects its address<br>Open world: changes the customer's website |
| `seovision_act_on_quick_win`<br>Act on a Search Console quick win | false | true | true | Writes: adds an article to the plan, or updates a published one after a yes<br>Destructive: an update replaces the live article's text, keeping the old version<br>Open world: publishes to the live site |
| `seovision_add_competitor`<br>Add a competitor | false | true | false | Writes: adds a competitor to the project's registry<br>Destructive: an existing match is updated in place, taking the new name and becoming tracked and direct<br>Closed: only the project's own SeoVision data |
| `seovision_add_prompt`<br>Add an AI visibility prompt | false | false | false | Writes: adds one prompt to track<br>Not destructive: purely additive<br>Closed: saved inside SeoVision, nothing is sent out |
| `seovision_add_webflow_seo_fields`<br>Add the SEO fields to the Webflow collection | false | false | true | Writes: adds two SEO fields and maps them<br>Not destructive: only adds fields and fills empty mapping slots<br>Open world: changes the customer's Webflow collection |
| `seovision_agree_target_queries`<br>Agree with the 20 queries | false | false | false | Writes: marks the queries as agreed<br>Not destructive: only adds the agreement, the list stays the same<br>Closed: stays inside SeoVision |
| `seovision_apply_technical_seo_batch`<br>Apply a Technical SEO batch to the live site | false | true | true | Writes: changes the customer's live site after a yes<br>Destructive: overwrites titles, descriptions and other SEO fields there, undoable from a backup<br>Open world: writes to the customer's website or store |

| `seovision_unfreeze_project`<br>Unfreeze a project | false | false | false | Writes: re-activates a frozen project within the account's project limit<br>Not destructive: restores the project, removes nothing<br>Closed: only the account's own SeoVision data |
| `seovision_update_article`<br>Edit an article | false | true | true | Writes: edits an article<br>Destructive: overwrites its text or details, and can take a published article off a hosted blog<br>Open world: on a blog SeoVision hosts, a published article changes live at once |
| `seovision_update_article_settings`<br>Update article generation settings | false | true | false | Writes: saves the article settings<br>Destructive: replaces saved values, can clear the call-to-action link, and updates unpublished articles' display settings<br>Closed: published posts and the site are not touched |
| `seovision_update_author`<br>Edit an article author | false | true | true | Writes: edits an author's details<br>Destructive: replaces the saved name, title, bio, specialties or links<br>Open world: on a blog SeoVision hosts, the author's live articles show the change at once |
| `seovision_update_business_profile`<br>Edit the Business Profile | false | true | true | Writes: saves new wording after a confirmed preview<br>Destructive: replaces what the public profile page shows<br>Open world: the public page on seovision.io changes at once |
| `seovision_update_google_business_profile`<br>Change a Google Business Profile detail | false | true | true | Writes: changes one field of the business's Google profile<br>Destructive: replaces the field's current value, even though it can be undone<br>Open world: writes to Google Search and Maps |
| `seovision_update_hosted_blog_look`<br>Change the Hosted Blog look | false | true | true | Writes: saves the blog's colour, header links or logo removal<br>Destructive: replaces or removes the current values<br>Open world: changes the look of the public blog |
| `seovision_update_prompt`<br>Update an AI visibility prompt | false | true | false | Writes: edits or pauses a prompt<br>Destructive: replaces its text or stops its tracking<br>Closed: stays inside SeoVision |
| `seovision_update_publish_schedule`<br>Update article publishing schedule | false | true | true | Writes: changes when articles publish<br>Destructive: replaces the saved schedule and can stop live publishing<br>Open world: turning automatic publishing on posts articles to the customer's live site |
| `seovision_update_team_member_role`<br>Change a teammate's role | false | true | false | Writes: changes a teammate's role after a confirmed preview<br>Destructive: overwrites their access and can reduce it<br>Closed: the teammate is inside the account and no message is sent |
| `seovision_update_weak_article`<br>Update a weak article | false | true | true | Writes: rewrites a live article's text<br>Destructive: replaces the published text, kept for a restore<br>Open world: publishes the new text on the customer's website |
| `seovision_write_technical_seo_product_texts`<br>Have the AI write product selling points and answers | false | true | true | Writes: an AI model writes product texts during a scan<br>Destructive: the scan replaces unanswered fix proposals and may turn on or rebuild the public product feed<br>Open world: reads the live store |
| `seovision_write_technical_seo_titles`<br>Have the AI write page titles and descriptions | false | true | true | Writes: an AI model writes titles and descriptions during a scan<br>Destructive: the scan replaces unanswered fix proposals and may turn on or rebuild the public product feed<br>Open world: reads the live site |

## Not on this address

These tools exist on the server but are not listed here. Where one takes or shows a site's key or token, the person does that step on the matching card on the Settings → Integrations page of the SeoVision dashboard.

| Tool | Why it is left out |
| --- | --- |
| `seovision_get_billing_overview` | Shows the plan, its price and the next payment (OpenAI: no subscription plans on display). |
| `seovision_list_invoices` | Lists invoices with their payment pages (OpenAI: no link to a transactional page). |
| `seovision_get_subscription` | Shows the subscription, its prices and the trial (OpenAI: no subscription plans on display). |
| `seovision_get_account_usage` | Shows the plan and its price (OpenAI: no subscription plans on display). |
| `seovision_buy_credit_pack` | Answers the page that buys backlink credits (OpenAI: no selling of credits). |
| `seovision_regenerate_article_images` | Generates images through an AI model (Anthropic: image generation is not accepted). |
| `seovision_connect_wix` | Takes the site's Wix API key (OpenAI: no API keys, tokens or passwords in the chat). |
| `seovision_save_webflow_token` | Takes the site's Webflow API token (OpenAI: no API keys, tokens or passwords in the chat). |
| `seovision_replace_webflow_token` | Takes the site's Webflow API token (OpenAI: no API keys, tokens or passwords in the chat). |
| `seovision_generate_wordpress_token` | Hands out the plugin's access token (OpenAI: no API keys, tokens or passwords in the chat). |
| `seovision_connect_nextjs` | Hands out the blog's API key (OpenAI: no API keys, tokens or passwords in the chat). |
| `seovision_connect_custom_site` | Hands out the receiver's access token (OpenAI: no API keys, tokens or passwords in the chat). |

`https://app.seovision.io/api/directory/claude/mcp` lists the same tools with the same hints, without these:

| Tool | Why it is left out |
| --- | --- |
